Cvent provides meetings, events, and hospitality technology. The Software Engineer I builds and ships web application features, integrates them with Cvent’s cloud platform, and collaborates with an agile team to improve software quality and reliability.

Responsibilities
Design, build, and test responsive, accessible, user-friendly web applications using modern front-end frameworks and libraries
Develop new features and integrate them with Cvent’s cloud-based platform and services
Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code and take part in code reviews
Investigate, debug, and resolve software issues, and help improve reliability and performance
Collaborate with other product teams across the Cvent suite to ensure systems integrate and work together smoothly
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and help improve team engineering practices
Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly to boost productivity and code quality

Working knowledge of SQL, including writing queries and stored procedures (T-SQL a plus)
Experience designing, building, and consuming RESTful web services (JSON)
Foundation in object-oriented programming
Familiarity with Git and collaborative version control workflows
Understanding of build and CI/CD tools such as Gradle, Maven, or Jenkins
Exposure to cloud platforms
Strong problem-solving skills and a collaborative, curious mindset

Java preferred

Cloud platforms, preferably AWS (CloudFront a plus)
Experience with GraphQL APIs
Experience with a modern front-end framework (e.g., React, Angular, or Vue) and TypeScript
Familiarity with automated testing (unit, integration, end-to-end)
Exposure to enterprise SDLC and agile/Scrum environments

Bonus depending on factors such as job-related knowledge, relevant experience, and location
